_comment: Evolution framing after Canty & Abolhasani, Nat. Rev. Chem. 2026, 10, 523-537 (https://doi.org/10.1038/s41570-026-00847-2). Eras periodise the field's arc toward networked SDLs / collective scientific superintelligence (CSS); milestones follow the review's Table 1, restricted to platforms with a map entry. Axes: G generalizability, S scalability, D comprehensive structured (meta)data. Notes are data-level English (like entry fields).

milestones.name: ARES OS
milestones.note: First major infrastructure package for SDL deployment; proper database organization of experimental data

milestones.name: Chemputer
milestones.note: Device and protocol abstraction — chemistry digitalized as executable code

milestones.name: Mobile Robot Chemist
milestones.note: Extensibility through mechanical training; physical agent decoupled from apparatus scaling

milestones.name: CAMEO
milestones.note: Opt-in human collaboration; joint phase mapping and property optimization at the beamline

milestones.name: AMANDA
milestones.note: Multiplatform control architecture; data and hardware integration structuring

milestones.name: Reconfigurable flow (Nambiar et al.)
milestones.note: Online reconfiguration of flow chemistry systems

milestones.name: AlphaFlow
milestones.note: Variable-process multistep nanoparticle optimization in flow

milestones.name: FINALES
milestones.note: Decentralized experimental + simulation control; BattINFO ontology for data capture

milestones.name: A-Lab
milestones.note: Intensive solids handling — solid-state synthesis of complex powders

milestones.name: CoScientist
milestones.note: LLM-based experimental design, planning, and execution

milestones.name: AMD Platform
milestones.note: Closed-loop multistep synthesis with automatic process rectification

milestones.name: RoboChem
milestones.note: Multiscale operation in flow — photocatalytic optimization and scale-up

milestones.name: MINERVA
milestones.note: ELN/LIMS integration via OpenBIS — the data layer built in
